svg.title: The three-month average of monthly job change stood at 51,000 in September 2026, a preliminary figure, and payrolls shrank in seven of the 57 months charted.
svg.desc: Columns show the monthly change in payroll jobs from January 2022 to September 2026: large gains in 2022, up to 819,000 in February, that shrink to under 200,000 a month by 2025, with seven months of losses in 2025 and 2026. A line shows the three-month average, which stood at 51,000 in September 2026, a preliminary figure. Set in Inter and Inter Tight. Without both fonts installed, the labels set in another font and change width.
svg.text: Jobs added or lost in the month
